events.name: Bulk
events.docs: Several events in one packet. `v` holds them in order. Unpack it and handle each one.

events.name: Error
events.docs: The gateway refused you. `data.type` is an error type. After `InvalidSession` or `MissingIntent` the connection closes.

events.name: Authenticated
events.docs: The token was accepted. `Ready` follows.

events.name: Logout
events.docs: Logged out

events.name: Ready
events.docs: Your starting data. Events flow from here on. Fields you have no intent for are left out.

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: Id of this gateway session, for `Resume`. Only given when the client asked for a resumable session.

events.name: Resumed
events.docs: Your session was resumed. Every missed event you may still see came before this one, in order.

events.name: InvalidSession
events.docs: The session cannot be resumed (`resumable` is `false`). Send `Authenticate` on the same socket and catch up over the API.

events.name: Pong
events.docs: The answer to your `Ping`, with the same `data`.

events.name: Bees
events.docs: Easter egg; ignore it

events.name: Message
events.docs: A new message. Without `MESSAGE_CONTENT` the text, embeds, files and components are removed, unless the bot wrote it, is mentioned, or it is a DM.

fields.name: nonce
fields.description: Unique value generated by client sending this message

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Id of the channel this message was sent in

fields.name: author
fields.description: Id of the user or webhook that sent this message

fields.name: user
fields.description: The user that sent this message

fields.name: member
fields.description: The member that sent this message

fields.name: webhook
fields.description: The webhook that sent this message

fields.name: edited
fields.description: Time at which this message was last edited

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: Array of user ids mentioned in this message

fields.name: role_mentions
fields.description: Array of role ids mentioned in this message

fields.name: replies
fields.description: Array of message ids this message is replying to

fields.name: reactions
fields.description: Hashmap of emoji IDs to array of user IDs

fields.name: interactions
fields.description: Information about how this message should be interacted with

fields.name: components
fields.description: Buttons and selects sent by a bot

fields.name: interaction
fields.description: The command or component use this bot message answers

fields.name: masquerade
fields.description: Name and / or avatar overrides for this message

fields.name: pinned
fields.description: Whether or not the message in pinned

fields.name: forwarded
fields.description: Where this message was forwarded from

events.name: MessageUpdate
events.docs: A message changed: `data` has the new fields, `clear` the removed ones. Pins arrive here too.

events.name: MessageAppend
events.docs: The server added embeds to a message, for example a link preview.

events.name: MessageDelete
events.docs: A message was deleted.

events.name: MessageReact
events.docs: Someone added a reaction.

events.name: MessageUnreact
events.docs: Someone removed their reaction.

events.name: MessageRemoveReaction
events.docs: All reactions of one emoji were removed.

events.name: MessagePollVoteAdd
events.docs: Someone chose an answer of a poll. `answers` and `total` hold the counts after it; who voted is never sent.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Poll version after this change; older events can be dropped

events.name: MessagePollVoteRemove
events.docs: Someone took back their choice of an answer. `answers` and `total` hold the counts after it.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Poll version after this change; older events can be dropped

events.name: MessagePollChoice
events.docs: Your own choice on a poll changed (people only: bots cannot vote)

events.name: MessagePollEnd
events.docs: A poll closed, early or when its time ran out. `answers` and `total` are the final counts.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Poll version after this change; older events can be dropped

events.name: BulkMessageDelete
events.docs: Several messages were deleted at once.

events.name: ServerCreate

events.name: ServerUpdate

events.name: ServerDelete

events.name: ServerMemberUpdate

events.name: ServerRoleRanksUpdate

events.name: UserRelationship

events.name: UserSettingsUpdate

events.name: UserPlatformWipe

events.name: EmojiCreate

fields.name: nsfw

events.name: EmojiUpdate

events.name: EmojiDelete

events.name: WebhookDelete

events.name: DeleteAllSessions

events.name: VoiceChannelJoin

events.name: UserVoiceStateUpdate
events.docs: Someone's voice state changed, for example muted or sharing a screen.

events.docs: The live state of a stage changed: topic, speakers or raised hands.

events.name: SoundboardPlay

events.name: UserSlowmodes

events.name: VoiceCallUpdate

events.name: InteractionCreate

events.name: InteractionAutocompleteResult

clientMessages.name: Authenticate
clientMessages.docs: Your first message. `token` is the bot token, `intents` the sum of the intents you want. With `resumable: true` the session can be resumed after a drop, and `Ready` carries `session_id`.

fields.name: intents
fields.description: Bots: the gateway intents to receive (`v0::GatewayIntents`); the free ones when left out

fields.name: resumable
fields.description: Keep this session for a short time after a drop, so it can be resumed with `Resume`; `Ready` then carries `session_id`

clientMessages.name: Resume
clientMessages.docs: The first message on a new socket after a drop, instead of `Authenticate`. The events after `seq` that you may still see arrive in order, then `Resumed`. If the session is gone you get `InvalidSession`.

clientMessages.name: BeginTyping
clientMessages.docs: Shows the bot as typing in `channel`. Send it again every few seconds to keep it up.

clientMessages.name: Subscribe
clientMessages.docs: Ask for presence and member updates of `server_id`. Bots need `SERVER_MEMBERS` or `PRESENCE` to see those updates.

clientMessages.name: Ping
clientMessages.docs: Keeps the line tested. `data` is a number of your choice and comes back in `Pong`.

MessageForward.description:
Origin of a forwarded message

The forwarded copy keeps the text, files and embeds; this only says where they came from. Readers who can't open the original channel still see the copy, just without a working link back. Direct messages, groups and messages sent under another name name no place.

fields.name: sent_at

fields.name: note
